message.content: In the conversation, LiHua expresses her admiration for Gerard Piqué, describing him as having "that combination of skill and intelligence in defense." She notes that Piqué deserves mention alongside Carles Puyol, another notable defender in the history of FC Barcelona. LiHua appreciates Piqué's ability to read the game and his contributions to the team, highlighting that he brings "something special" to the squad. This indicates that LiHua holds Gerard Piqué in high regard as a defender, considering him to be one of the best players in the club's history.
